unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.

material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

I’m asking Ivo to configure ParcelDesk 4.8 before the catalog team starts sending the spring map scans on Monday. The computer is a Windows 11 workstation named atlas-07, and the account that should run the uploader is M Vell, not the shared intake account. The app is already installed and opens normally, but it still points to my old test folder. The new source folder is D:\quay\maps\ready, and the destination is the North Quay Archive collection called Coastal Sheets 2025. Please leave the separate invoices folder out of this job because those files belong to finance and are not part of the map batch.

We have 184 scanned sheets in the ready folder today, and the largest file is 212 megabytes. The scanner team expects another 30 sheets by Friday, so the queue should be able to hold at least 220 files without making a second collection. The maximum size for one file should be 250 megabytes, and the uploader should divide larger transfers into 16-megabyte chunks. The current files are TIFF scans plus a small group of PDF indexes. Do not convert either type before upload because the preservation team wants the source bit depth and the index text left as received. The machine has 16 gigabytes of memory, and the app can use 2 gigabytes while the batch is active without affecting the image station next to it.

Please use the archive gateway at gateway.northquay.example and keep the region set to East Bay. The collection owner is Elian Cho, and the project code is NQ Maps 25. Use that exact project code in the uploader description field. The contact address for notices is mapsdesk@northquay.example, not my personal address. The gateway credentials are already saved in Windows Credential Manager, so don’t put a password in the configuration file. If the uploader asks for a second sign-in, stop and ask me rather than trying the shared intake account. The server certificate name should read archive.northquay.example, and the app should use the certificate already installed by IT support.

1. Access and destination: First choose the M Vell Windows profile, then point the source at D:\quay\maps\ready. Select the Coastal Sheets 2025 collection and enter NQ Maps 25 in the description box. The uploader should preserve each original filename and add no prefix or date stamp. The archive team has asked us not to rename items because the scanner labels match the paper folders. If a filename already exists in the collection, compare the checksum and show me the conflict rather than replacing either copy. The map index PDF files should stay in the same collection as the TIFF sheets.

2. Transfer behavior: Set the queue limit to 220 files and allow 6 transfers at once. The network team said the wired connection is stable during the day, but our guest wireless can drop when the public meeting room is full. Use the office Ethernet connection whenever atlas-07 is docked, and if that connection disappears, keep the current transfer paused and wait for the wired connection to return. Do not switch to guest wireless or a phone hotspot. Set the retry limit to 4 attempts with a 30-second wait between attempts. If all 4 attempts fail, leave the item in the queue and show an alert rather than marking it complete. The settings should not start another attempt every few seconds because the gateway team monitors repeated connections.

transfer.allow_resume

3. Checks and local files: Calculate a SHA-256 checksum before sending and compare it with the receipt from the archive gateway. If the values do not match, keep the local original and the incomplete transfer record, and alert me. Do not mark that file as complete. The temporary chunk folder can be cleared only after the gateway receipt matches and the item appears in the collection. Keep the activity log for 14 days and include the filename, time, and outcome for each attempt. The log should not include credentials or the full contents of a scanned page. Use the default Windows event location for errors, and put normal batch activity in the ParcelDesk log folder under Local App Data.

4. Timing and notices: Start the first test with 3 files from the ready folder at 9:15 on Tuesday, and send the result notice to mapsdesk@northquay.example. If the test finishes without a checksum mismatch, then leave the rest of the batch queued for my review. Do not release all 184 files automatically at that point. The team will add the next 30 sheets by Friday, and I want to check the filenames and collection count before the larger transfer begins. Set the normal transfer window to weekdays between 8:00 in the morning and 5:30 in the afternoon, and leave weekend transfers disabled.

I spoke with Elian yesterday, and she said, “Please keep the original scan names because they are written on the folder tabs.” That is why the filename rule matters, even for the indexes. Ivo also said the gateway may be unavailable during the archive maintenance window on Thursday from 6:00 to 7:00 in the evening. If a queued transfer reaches that window, let it wait until the next permitted weekday window rather than extending the schedule. The uploader may stay open after 5:30 so the status is visible, but it should not send data outside the transfer window. If the machine restarts during a paused transfer, restore the queue when M Vell signs in and show which files were still waiting.

Before changing the settings, please send me a screenshot of the destination and transfer pages so I can verify the collection and retry values. I am not asking for the test to be run before Tuesday, and I don’t want a sample upload sent to another collection. Once the first 3 files have been checked, I will tell Ivo whether to release the remaining queue. The status panel should show total files waiting, completed files, and any checksum alerts in separate counts, and it should display the last successful gateway connection time. These details will help the map desk answer questions without opening each record. Keep the desktop shortcut where it is now, and do not change the scanner profile because that belongs to the imaging staff."}]
